crossRefs.note: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
“Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…

translations.web: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
translations.bsb: He does not let me catch my breath, but overwhelms me with bitterness.
translations.kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
translations.asv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.
